description: This PHP class 'AuthValidateController' is part of a human resource management system. It handles authentication validation requests by processing user credentials provided via HTTP requests, invoking authentication services, and returning a JSON response indicating success or failure.

classes.name: AuthValidateController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling authentication validation requests by verifying credentials and returning authentication status.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the AuthenticationService instance used to validate user credentials.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the HTTP request containing user credentials, authenticates the user via the authentication service, updates the user authentication state, and returns a JSON response indicating success or failure.
